title: Hermes tools via client-local function protocol
description: Advertises bare Hermes tools (read_file, search_files, web_search) through the client-local function protocol and dispatches each call to the shared Hermes runtime: preferentially over the hermes-chat-lifecycle IPC (phase=tool_call, conversation-keyed, no gizmo required), falling back to the loopback HTTP tool endpoint when the lifecycle bridge is absent.
